narration: Cyber Monday was invented by a marketing firm in 2005 to extend Black Friday online. It's not a shopping event — it's a psychological operation. And today, it fires all at once.
visual: Shopping cart SVG with pulsing amber '70% OFF' badge, 'CYBER MONDAY WAS INVENTED BY MARKETERS' title animating in with spring effect, dark background

narration: Here's the thing — 92% of Cyber Monday deals were the same price or cheaper just weeks ago. That 'was $249' label was never $249. It's a reference price, and it's completely legal.
visual: Two price tags side by side — 'October' showing $89, 'Cyber Monday' showing $89 with animated strikethrough over fake $249 original price. Light background.

narration: That countdown timer ticking at the top? It resets the second it hits zero. The '2 left in stock' warning shows whether there are 2 or 2,000. Urgency is manufactured, not real.
visual: Animated countdown timer ticking down in monospace font, pulsing red 'ONLY 2 LEFT IN STOCK' badge below it, dark background with amber accent glow

narration: You abandoned your cart on purpose to test the price. Fifteen minutes later your phone buzzes: 10% off, just for you. That discount was always available — they were waiting for you to walk away.
visual: Phone silhouette with red notification badge, popup showing cart abandonment email with '10% OFF — JUST FOR YOU' message, light background

narration: The average shopper plans to spend $400 on Cyber Monday and walks away having spent $1,900. That $1,500 gap isn't bad math — it's the precise result of decades of behavioral engineering.
visual: Dollar counter animating from $400 to $1,900 in large amber text, two progress bars comparing planned vs actual spend, person silhouette with empty wallet, dark background

narration: Before you click buy now, check the price history. CamelCamelCamel for Amazon, Google Shopping everywhere else. The deal ending in two hours will be back — usually for less. Now you know.
visual: Magnifying glass SVG over a price chart showing peaks and dips, three animated checklist steps sliding in: Check price history, Compare on Google Shopping, Wait 24 hours. Light background.
